alex.k: Hey @sarah.security — requesting ephemeral console/DB elevation to run a targeted psql reindex on prod. Search latency spike traced to a corrupted index on the embeddings table. Need a 45m window starting now (or ASAP). I'll only touch one index and one table.

alex.k: Commands I plan to run:```psql -h prod-db-primary.redwood-db.internal -U svc-alex -d redwood_prod 
BEGIN;
-- verify rows
SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE vector IS NULL;
REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY public.embeddings_vector_idx;
COMMIT;```

alex.k: Ticket INC-3214 referenced. Justification: urgent partial reindex to recover search tail latency. Will record session and post SQL/logs back to the ticket.

sarah.security: Can you confirm the exact host/user, the minimum privileges you need (not full superuser ideally), and that no export of PII will happen? Also we require session recording + audit entry and a short rollback plan.

alex.k: Host: `prod-db-primary.redwood-db.internal`
User: `svc-alex-ephemeral` (JIT account)
Privileges: `REINDEX` on `public.embeddings_vector_idx` and `SELECT` on `public.embeddings` (no superuser).
PII export: none — read-only checks + reindex.
Rollback plan: if REINDEX fails or increases latency, I'll stop and notify SRE, revoke write access, and coordinate a replica failover with @mike.sre. Will post exact steps in INC-3214.

jordan: please add the exact `psql` invocations you'll run to the ticket (so we can replay). Also tag @oncall-sre before starting.

sarah.security: OK — conditionally approve 45m JIT elevation for `svc-alex-ephemeral`. Requirements: session recording enabled, record audit comment in INC-3214, limit scope to specified index/table, and tag @oncall-sre and @mike.sre. If anything unexpected, revoke immediately. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

access-bot: Granted temporary role `tmp-db-reindex` to `svc-alex-ephemeral` for 45 minutes. Session recording enabled. Session link: https://access.internal/sessions/abc123 (expires in 45m). Audit ID: AUD-20240318-9987.

mike.sre: I see the plan — I'll be on standby and watching metrics. If latency increases >20% I'll trigger the failover plan.

alex.k: Thanks all — starting now. Will post SQL output and timing to INC-3214 and paste any error snippets here. :rocket:
